title: Crystal Vale
body:
Crystal Vale is a crossroads of four wild biomes around a walled city.

Merchants trade wood, stone and rare relics. Adventurers hunt, harvest and answer quests that keep the gates safe.

Press Q anytime to open this menu — inventory, skill tree, system, wiki and quests.

title: Controls
body:
Move: WASD
Jump: Space · Sprint: Shift
Attack / Harvest: J · Interact: F · Trade: K
Bomb: B (hold to aim) · Cycle weapon: V
Potion: 1 · Antidote: 2
Dash: C · Heal: E · Power Strike: R
Pause menu: Q

title: Combat
body:
Melee swings hit creatures and also chop trees or mine rocks when you face them.

Bombs deal area damage — hold B to aim, release to throw.

Spend skill points in the Skills tab: Vitality/Fortitude raise HP, Strength/Power raise attack, Agility/Swift/Windwalker raise speed. Titan needs Fortitude and Power first.

title: Inventory & Craft
body:
Harvested wood and stone land in your bag and resource chips.

Potions heal; antidotes clear poison. Bombs stack high — buy more from the merchant.

Quest rewards (pelts, fiber, relics…) also stack. Select a slot in Inventory to read the item description.

title: Four Biomes
body:
North — Dark Forest: wolves, timber, shadowed paths.
East — Desert: cactus fiber, heat and sand creatures.
South — Swamp: silk, moss potions, slow ground.
West — Mountain Peaks: iron, ancient relics, thin air.

The city plaza (0,0) is the safest respawn. Gates sit just outside the walls.

title: Quests
body:
Talk to Dialogue NPCs with F to start or turn in quests.

The Quests tab lists active progress, completed and failed jobs.

Objectives usually ask for kills, harvests or deliveries. Rewards may include gold, items and skill points.

title: Merchant
body:
Press K near the merchant to trade.

Buy bombs, potions and gear upgrades (sword levels, speed ring).

Sell surplus materials when your bag fills. Gold also tracks on the HUD chip.

title: Level & Skills
body:
Defeat enemies and finish quests to gain XP. Each level grants skill points.

The rune pillar in the city can grant extra points.

Skill tree tiers unlock after prerequisites: roots (Vitality / Strength / Agility) → mid (Fortitude / Power / Swift) → apex (Titan / Windwalker).

title: Save & Load
body:
Open System (Q → System) and use Save Game / Load Game.

Progress stores locally in the browser: inventory, XP, skills, quests and merchant upgrades.

Music and SFX sliders apply immediately.
